source: ENHANCEMENT_PLAN_2026-10-05.md (G5a, G10 safety check, H13/H19/H23 single-change arms). Same plan_id, dataset, protocol and memspine_base as plans/aamas_runs.json (copied, not referenced), so the runs share its prefix and plan_report.py / significance.py read them alongside the main plan. Keys checked against memspine.config.schema and core.policies.assembly.AssemblyOptions.

projection_assumptions.note: Completion tokens per call are assumptions (the stub's replies are not the model's). Prompt tokens are measured on the stub run (chars/4). 'ceiling' uses each caller's max_tokens, or the prompt's token_budget for engine roles, which send no max_tokens.

arms.benchmark: LoCoMo cat 5 (adversarial; gold is an abstention)
arms.notes: combo-A (config copied from aamas_runs.json) on cat 5 only, dated prompt: the abstention baseline for cat5-infer. The rubric judge is abstention-aware.

arms.benchmark: LoCoMo cat 5 (adversarial; gold is an abstention)
arms.notes: same as cat5-dated with the inference-aware prompt; a drop against cat5-dated is hallucination on unanswerable questions. Needs --qa-prompt dated_infer in the harness (added on another branch); not rehearsable before that lands.
extra BM25 leg over the question's core terms, fused by RRF; needs read.hybrid (default true). One change on memspine-base.
Mem++ latest-dated slot reservation (AssemblyOptions.latest_slots); 3 slots as in the tests. One change on memspine-base.
Mnemon near-duplicate removal (AssemblyOptions.dedupe_jaccard, word-set Jaccard >= 0.8). One change on memspine-base.

Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B (Apache-2.0) via read.rerank: qwen3, memspine[st] (transformers + torch) and a ~1.2 GB model download; pool 3x, [Date:] prefix, skip for ordering, as R-bge / R-cohere. Without the extra the engine skip-logs and runs combo-A-pool, so check the rerank log line before trusting a score. Control: combo-A-pool.
